python3 -c "
import math

# Values in millions of dollars
values = [266837, 274362, 277949]

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(values) / len(values)
print(f'Mean: {mean}')

# Calculate squared differences from mean
squared_diffs = [(x - mean) ** 2 for x in values]
print(f'Squared differences: {squared_diffs}')

# Population variance (divide by N)
pop_variance = sum(squared_diffs) / len(values)
print(f'Population variance: {pop_variance}')

# Population standard deviation
pop_std = math.sqrt(pop_variance)
print(f'Population standard deviation: {pop_std}')

# Sample variance (divide by N-1)
sample_variance = sum(squared_diffs) / (len(values) - 1)
print(f'Sample variance: {sample_variance}')

# Sample standard deviation
sample_std = math.sqrt(sample_variance)
print(f'Sample standard deviation: {sample_std}')

print(f'\\nPopulation std rounded to nearest tenth: {round(pop_std, 1)}')
print(f'Sample std rounded to nearest tenth: {round(sample_std, 1)}')
"
